content: Root cause: The bug was caused by changes introduced by an IBM JDK compatibility patch that affected the handling of Object Identifiers (OIDs) in the SPNEGO (Simple and Protected GSSAPI Negotiation Mechanism) authentication process. Specifically, the original code was using a method that was incompatible with the new JDK changes, leading to failures in creating the necessary GSS context for Kerberos authentication. The patch modifies the way OIDs are retrieved and used, ensuring compatibility with the updated JDK and restoring the functionality of SPNEGO.
